faq_heading: Vancouver Heights houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Vancouver Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Vancouver Heights, Burnaby: 13 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 38%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 16 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Vancouver Heights fell from 16 in June to 13 in September (−18.8%), and 11 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.8% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Vancouver Heights?
Vancouver Heights also had 22 condos and townhomes listed and 1 sold in September, against 13 houses listed. The Vancouver Heights condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Vancouver Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

19 houses sold in Vancouver Heights with a median price of $2,075,000 (the middle half sold between $1,665,000 and $2,221,500), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $770 per square foot, a median year built of 1978 and a median lot of 4,049 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Vancouver Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Vancouver Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Vancouver Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Vancouver Heights had a sales ratio of 38%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Vancouver Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Vancouver Heights over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Vancouver Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Vancouver Heights sell for?
faq.a: 19 houses sold in Vancouver Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,075,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Vancouver Heights?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
